selectionPolicy: Editorial illustrations selected for recognizable connections to the study family, before inspecting student budgets. Not a representative sample, a degree earnings distribution, or an exhaustive list. Only exact CIP-linked base O*NET occupations; one example per wage SOC. No automatic high-pay fallback.
entryDefinition: Mean wage of the lowest-paid third of workers in each occupation and location. An entry-pay proxy, not an observed graduate starting salary.
medianDefinition: 50th percentile across workers in each occupation and location. Not a future salary or a promised progression.
